description: This file defines an internal interface IResourceSelector<T> within the Orleans.Streams namespace, which specifies methods for selecting resources from a list, including a property for the count of resources and a method for selecting a subset without overlap.

classes.name: IResourceSelector<T>
classes.description: An internal interface for selecting a specified number of resources from a resource list, with a method to get the next selection avoiding overlap.

methods.name: NextSelection
methods.description: Attempts to select a specified number of resources from the resource list, ensuring no overlap with existing selections.
